summary: CRT-style string helper: reads the float pointed to by a2, formats it into a local buffer with the '%.5f' format string (literal at 0x005CD130) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then appends the formatted text to the destination string a1 with strcat. Always returns 0.

local_names.v3: float value read from *a2, promoted to double for formatting

operations.description: Read the value to format: v3 = *a2 (a float promoted to double).
Initialize the local buffer as an empty string: v4[0] = 0.
Format the value into the buffer: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, "%.5f", v3); the format literal a5f lives at global 0x005CD130.
Append the formatted text to the destination: strcat(a1, v4).
Invoked by ConfigKeyValueWrite (0x004B1E20) to append a float value while writing a config key.

unresolved: The owner type is unknown; this is a standalone CRT-style helper with no class association evidenced.
The destination buffer a1 capacity and lifetime are caller-managed; the strcat is safe only if the caller reserved enough space.
Whether the fixed '%.5f' precision represents a specific game quantity (time, scalar, etc.) is not evidenced here.
